Why it is here: promotional content

Find your perfect coffee match this Black Friday with Nespresso

Shake up your coffee routine with seasonal Vertuo flavours, limited-edition sparkle and Black Friday offers from Nespresso.

Whether you’re refreshing your coffee routine, looking for a gift for a coffee lover, or hoping to make the most of the Black Friday sales, Nespresso has plenty to discover this season.

Explore Vertuo coffees ranging from rich and intense to sweet and dessert-inspired, alongside limited-time savings on a machine and plenty of pods. Christmas gifting is covered too, with the Nespresso x Swarovski collection bringing a little extra sparkle to the festivities.

Whatever your coffee style, there are plenty of ways to make your everyday cup feel that bit more special.

Explore the new Nespresso Vertuo coffee pod range and find your new favourite

Hazelnut Brownie

Nespresso Hazelnut Brownie puts a festive twist on a classic cup of coffee, perfect if you prefer a sweet, nutty flavour in your coffee. Rich brownie fudge is paired with the warm aroma of roasted hazelnuts, all built around a smooth 100 per cent arabica coffee base.

Designed to make a 230ml mug, it's best served as a long coffee. Try it with foamed milk for an indulgent cappuccino, over ice, or shake things up completely and add milk and a touch of chocolate syrup to create a Hazelnut Pink Brownie Mocktini.

Buy the limited-edition Nespresso x Swarovski Hazelnut Brownie Vertuo pods now for £8.90

Blueberry Cheesecake

If you're looking to expand your coffee palate with a sweet and fruity twist, the Blueberry Cheesecake pods could be right up your street. Another flavour from the Nespresso x Swarovski Festive Collection, it combines jammy blueberry flavours with rich cheesecake and notes of smooth caramel.

The flavoured coffee has a smooth 100 per cent arabica base, made with beans primarily from Brazil and Colombia, with each Vertuo pod producing a generous 230ml mug. Enjoy as is or with milk, hot or iced.

Buy the limited-edition Nespresso x Swarovski Blueberry Cheesecake Vertuo Pods now for £8.90

Crystal Spark Double Espresso

The Crystal Spark Double Espresso may be better suited to you if you're after a coffee that's bold, intense and full of character. This limited-edition blend brings together arabica beans from origins including Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Guatemala and Indonesia, producing biscuity and fruity notes with subtle hints of cocoa.

With an intensity rating of six, each capsule is designed to be enjoyed as an 80ml double espresso. It's not limited to this though, it's bright, nutty notes make it the perfect pour-over for a decadent Matcha Affogaccino.

Cinnamon Apple Crisp

If you want to fully embrace the flavours of autumn, the Nespresso Cinnamon Apple Crisp pods bring together cooked apple and spicy cinnamon with hints of biscuit and cake.

The result is reminiscent of a freshly baked apple pastry, with a 100 per cent arabica coffee base made using beans from Brazil, Colombia and other selected regions. Each Vertuo pod makes a 230ml mug, giving you a longer, dessert-inspired coffee.

Buy the Nespresso Cinnamon Apple Crisp Vertuo Pods now for £8.50

Maple Pecan

Sticking with autumnal flavours, Nespresso Maple Pecan pods combine the sweetness of maple syrup with the distinctive nuttiness from pecans. The flavours sit on a balanced, cereal-like 100% arabica coffee base made using beans from Brazil, Colombia and other selected regions.

There's plenty of room to experiment, the flavours are best served as either a 40ml espresso, an 110ml lungo or a 230ml mug. Adding a dash of milk helps dial up the creamy caramel flavour, too.

Buy the limited-edition Nespresso Maple Pecan Vertuo Pods now for £8.50

Golden Caramel

Or if you prefer to keep things more classic with rich, sweet and smooth flavours, the Golden Caramel pods could be calling your name. Part of the Barista Creations range, this flavoured coffee combines classic caramel with sweet biscuit notes, layered over a blend of Latin American and African arabicas. Each pod makes a generous 230ml mug, or you can use Coffee Creations Mode for a shorter 80ml serve. If you really want the caramel and biscuit notes to pop, try serving with milk, hot or iced.

Buy the Nespresso Golden Caramel Vertuo Pods now for £7.70

Shop Nespresso's Black Friday deals

If you've been thinking about setting up your own at-home coffee station, Nespresso's Black Friday bundle is a great opportunity to get started. For just £89, you'll get a Vertuo Next coffee machine, an Aeroccino milk frother, two travel mugs, and 50 coffee pods, giving you plenty of choice to experiment with and saving you over £200.

But hurry, offer ends on the 1st of December.

Alternatively, if you already have a Nespresso Vertuo machine, it's a great time to stock up on your favourite coffee pods with a saving of 20 per cent when you buy 250 pods or more and use the code BF26 at checkout. Stick with your tried-and-tested favourites or explore the many blends and flavours across the Nespresso range.

But hurry, offer ends on the 30th of November.

Discover the limited-edition Nespresso x Swarovski collection

The Nespresso x Swarovski collection doesn't end with pods, the limited-edition CitiZ Platinum offers another way to add some sparkle to your coffee routine. Finished in chrome and embellished with Swarovski crystals, this compact machine is designed to make a statement on the kitchen worktop.…
